title: Copper binding leads to increased dynamics in the regulatory N-terminal domain of full-length human copper transporter ATP7B.
authors: Oradd, Fredrik; Steffen, Jonas Hyld; Gourdon, Pontus; Andersson, Magnus
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究铜转运蛋白ATP7B的铜结合动态调控，对象为金属蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无TF-DNA结合或核酸互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ATP7B is a human copper-transporting P1B-type ATPase that is involved in copper homeostasis and resistance to platinum drugs in cancer cells. ATP7B consists of a copper-transporting core and a regulatory N-terminal tail that contains six metal-binding domains (MBD1-6) connected by linker regions. The MBDs can bind copper, which changes the dynamics of the regulatory domain and activates the protein, but the underlying mechanism remains unknown. To identify possible copper-specific structural dynamics involved in transport regulation, we constructed a model of ATP7B spanning the N-terminal tail and core catalytic domains and performed molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with (holo) and without (apo) copper ions bound to the MBDs. In the holo protein, MBD2, MBD3 and MBD5 showed enhanced mobilities, which resulted in a more extended N-terminal regulatory region. The observed separation of MBD2 and MBD3 from the core protein supports a mechanism where copper binding activates the ATP7B protein by reducing interactions among MBD1-3 and between MBD1-3 and the core protein. We also observed an increased interaction between MBD5 and the core protein that brought the copper-binding site of MBD5 closer to the high-affinity internal copper-binding site in the core protein. The simulation results assign specific, mechanistic roles to the metal-binding domains involved in ATP7B regulation that are testable in experimental settings.
abstract_zh: ATP7B是一种人类铜转运P1B型ATP酶，参与铜稳态及癌细胞对铂类药物的耐药性。ATP7B由一个铜转运核心和一个调节性N端尾部组成，后者包含六个金属结合域（MBD1-6），由连接区相连。MBDs能够结合铜，这改变了调节域的动态特性并激活蛋白质，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。为识别可能参与转运调节的铜特异性结构动态，我们构建了一个涵盖N端尾部及核心催化域的ATP7B模型，并进行了分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，分别在有（holo）和无（apo）铜离子结合于MBDs的条件下进行。在holo蛋白中，MBD2、MBD3和MBD5表现出增强的流动性，导致N端调节区域更加伸展。观察到的MBD2和MBD3与核心蛋白的分离支持一种机制，即铜结合通过减少MBD1-3之间以及MBD1-3与核心蛋白之间的相互作用来激活ATP7B蛋白。我们还观察到MBD5与核心蛋白之间的相互作用增强，使MBD5的铜结合位点更接近核心蛋白中高亲和力的内部铜结合位点。模拟结果为参与ATP7B调节的金属结合域赋予了具体的机制性角色，这些角色可在实验环境中进行验证。
